item.title: Amazon plans thousands more corporate job cuts next week, sources say
item.description: Amazon is planning a second round of job cuts next week as part of its broader goal of trimming some 30,000 corporate workers, Azernews reports citing Reuters.

item.title: Scientists solve 66 million-year-old mystery of how Earth’s greenhouse age ended
item.description: A 66 million-year-old mystery behind how our planet transformed from a tropical greenhouse to the ice-capped world of today has been unravelled by scientists, Azernews reports citing EurekAlert.

item.title: Inter fight back to beat Pisa 6-2 and maintain control in title race
item.description: Inter Milan found themselves two goals down to relegation-battling Pisa but fought back to earn a 6-2 win at the San Siro on Saturday, as the hosts continue to set the pace at the top of the Serie A standings, Azernews reports citing Reuters.

item.title: Gulf military buildup explained: US, Iran, and regional risks
item.description: As a United States aircraft carrier strike group, centred on the USS Abraham Lincoln, heads towards the Gulf, the world watches with unease.

item.title: Gulf Energy Exchange unveils world’s first oil-backed digital asset OIL1
item.description: The Gulf Energy Exchange (GEX) announced the launch of OIL1, the world’s first oil-backed digital asset that links the global energy sector with blockchain-based finance, Azernews reports citing Al Arabiya.

item.title: J.D. Vance’s South Caucasus trip and test for US diplomacy
item.description: US Vice President J.D. Vance is scheduled to visit Armenia and Azerbaijan in February 2026, in a high-level diplomatic trip aimed at reinforcing a U.S.-brokered peace process and advancing broader cooperation in the South Caucasus. US President Donald Trump announced the visit, highlighting its role in building on recent peace efforts between the two countries.

item.title: Aston Villa agree deal to sign Tammy Abraham
item.description: Aston Villa have reached a verbal agreement in principle to bring Tammy Abraham back to the Premier League, with the Besiktas deal now entering its final stages, Azernews reports citing OneFootball.

item.title: China’s Population Declines for Fourth Consecutive Year
item.description: China’s population has declined for the fourth consecutive year, underscoring the country’s deepening demographic challenges.

item.title: Azerbaijan and Bahrain seek to deepen parliamentary and political ties
item.description: Speaker of Azerbaijan’s Milli Majlis, Sahiba Gafarova, has met with King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa of the Kingdom of Bahrain as part of her official visit to the country, Azernews reports, citing a statement released by the Milli Majlis Press and Public Relations Department.

item.title: President Ilham Aliyev receives Minister of Foreign Affairs of Israel
item.description: President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev has received Minister of Foreign Affairs of the State of Israel, Gideon Sa'ar, Azernews reports.
